notes.title: Hotel Security Remake and New Content
notes.content: [h1][b]Hotel security is back with an update[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3]We have improved existing inconveniences on a large scale and added new content[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some UI images have been changed[/p][/*][*][p]All the inconveniences related to the report have been corrected[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560951/e96b54dccfc3c8bf4449d55db20fac8425df86a9.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]We added a sense of hostility so that we could know the enemy's information[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560951/528ac445a8e4ac858f6ed5bf85c99e6b0fcefeb8.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Other convenience items have been added[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Map An old motel has been added[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560951/9ca41f389dfa8da2ad6a030efda9f7cdb92d908c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Work on the map added with 3 new monsters[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560951/f770c321e84f0c0b3b6d761a90f41336fb0ab473.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]New maps are unlocked when two or more of the existing maps are cleared[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
